headlines.title: McDonald’s Has a Powerful Brand and a Growing Dividend. Is That Enough?
headlines.summary: McDonald’s Corporation (NYSE:MCD) brings together a restaurant brand that is world-famous with a business approach relying heavily on franchises and, as a result, produces a large amount of cash flow.

headlines.title: CDs vs. Dividend Stocks: The Income Gap Could Be Bigger Than Retirees Think
headlines.summary: Retirees chasing income face a choice that looks simple on paper but hides a tax trap, a reinvestment problem, and a dividend cut risk that most income comparisons never mention.

headlines.title: McDonald’s $3 meal deals aren't winning over enough customers
headlines.summary: McDonald’s is serving up new meal deals, but not winning back enough customers. On Fortune Daily, Phil Wahba explains why the chain's barrage of deals and marketing has fallen short.

headlines.title: Where Could McDonald's Next Growth Come From?
headlines.summary: McDonald's (MCD) shares have lost about 20% over the twelve months to October 9, 2026, while the S&P 500 gained about 17%. The U.S. market has been the weak spot. Executives acknowledged on their August 4 call that the domestic business struggled with execution during the second quarter. Yet that same discussion highlighted a new addition to the U.S. menu that is currently beating the company's internal plan. So what is it, and is it big enough to matter.

headlines.title: Chick-fil-A is keeping humans at the drive-thru while McDonald’s tests AI ordering and defends a separate pricing algorithm in court
headlines.summary: AI could ease restaurant workloads—or create new headaches. The stakes range from getting orders right to how menu prices are determined.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
